definitions.explanation: Relating to or derived from living matter; in agriculture, grown without synthetic chemicals.

examples.japanese: {有機|ゆうき}{野菜|やさい}を{買|か}う。
{有機|ゆうき}{栽培|さいばい}は{環境|かんきょう}にやさしい。
{有機|ゆうき}{化学|かがく}を{専攻|せんこう}しています。
この{店|みせ}では{有機|ゆうき}{農業|のうぎょう}で{育|そだ}てた{米|こめ}や{野菜|やさい}を{売|う}っている。
examples.english: This store sells rice and vegetables grown through organic farming.

examples.japanese: {有機|ゆうき}{栽培|さいばい}の{食材|しょくざい}は{値段|ねだん}が{高|たか}いが、{健康|けんこう}のために{選|えら}ぶ{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Organically grown ingredients are expensive, but more and more people are choosing them for their health.

notes:
{有機|ゆうき} means "organic" and is used as a prefix in both agricultural and scientific contexts. The kanji literally mean "having ({有|ゆう}) living structure ({機|き})."

AGRICULTURAL COMPOUNDS:
- {有機|ゆうき}{野菜|やさい}: organic vegetables
- {有機|ゆうき}{栽培|さいばい}: organic cultivation
- {有機|ゆうき}{農業|のうぎょう}: organic farming
- {有機|ゆうき}{農法|のうほう}: organic farming method

SCIENTIFIC COMPOUNDS:
- {有機|ゆうき}{化学|かがく}: organic chemistry
- {有機|ゆうき}{物|ぶつ}: organic matter
- {有機|ゆうき}{化合物|かごうぶつ}: organic compound

ANTONYM:
{無機|むき} (inorganic) — as in {無機|むき}{化学|かがく} (inorganic chemistry).

HOMOPHONE:
Do not confuse with {勇気|ゆうき} (courage) — same reading, different kanji.
